name: NVDA vs AMD: Performance, Correlation & Relative Strength
description: Research study comparing NVDA and AMD semiconductors across three dimensions: (1) Normalized performance indexed to 100 at start of period via cross-sectional lines, (2) 60-day rolling Pearson correlation of daily returns, (3) Relative strength ratio (NVDA/AMD price ratio) over time.
source:
# =============================================================================
# NVDA vs AMD: Performance, Correlation & Relative Strength
# =============================================================================
# 1. Normalized performance (indexed to 100) — cs_lines (both assets together)
# 2. 60-day rolling Pearson correlation of daily returns — xy_lines
# 3. Relative strength ratio (NVDA / AMD) — xy_lines
# =============================================================================

# --- Data: Universe source for normalized performance ---
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c

# Normalize each asset's close to 100 at start of period
first_close = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.First)(close)
normalized = close / first_close * 100

bar_ts = index()

# --- Chart 1: Normalized Performance (cross-sectional, one line per asset) ---
cs_lines(
    title='Normalized Performance (Indexed to 100)',
    category='1. Performance Comparison',
    y_axis_label='Index Level',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=0,
    order=1
)(bar_ts, normalized)

# --- Data: Load NVDA and AMD explicitly for pair-level metrics ---
nvda_o, nvda_h, nvda_l, nvda_c, nvda_v, nvda_vw, nvda_n = reference_stocks(ticker='NVDA')()
amd_o, amd_h, amd_l, amd_c, amd_v, amd_vw, amd_n = reference_stocks(ticker='AMD')()

nvda_close = ffill(nvda_c)
amd_close = ffill(amd_c)

# Daily returns for correlation
nvda_ret = returns(period=1)(nvda_close)
amd_ret = returns(period=1)(amd_close)

# 60-day rolling Pearson correlation
corr_60d = rolling_corr(window=60, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(nvda_ret, amd_ret)

# --- Chart 2: Rolling Correlation ---
xy_lines(
    title='NVDA vs AMD: 60-Day Rolling Correlation (Returns)',
    category='2. Rolling Correlation',
    y_axis_label='Pearson Correlation',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='0'),
        ReferenceLine(value=1, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='1.0')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='60d Rolling Correlation', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=2
)(bar_ts, corr_60d)

# --- Chart 3: Relative Strength Ratio (NVDA / AMD) ---
rel_strength = nvda_close / amd_close

xy_lines(
    title='Relative Strength: NVDA / AMD Price Ratio',
    category='3. Relative Strength',
    y_axis_label='NVDA / AMD Ratio',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=1, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Parity (1.0)')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='NVDA / AMD', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=3
)(bar_ts, rel_strength)
